about: Benchmark for the language-independent hesitation floor in code (FillerWords). Each case is a transcript as a speech model writes it and the text hush must insert. 'language' records the spoken language; the floor itself does not use it. A case with 'knownGap' records what the word list cannot do yet: it is measured but does not fail the run, and once it passes the benchmark asks for it to be promoted, so quality only moves up. Never edit an expected text to make a run pass.

cases.input: Um, so I think we should, uh, move the meeting to Monday.
cases.expected: So I think we should move the meeting to Monday.
cases.knownGap: 'um' and 'er' are real words in German and Portuguese, so the language-independent floor leaves them to the speech or language model.
